objective: Remove per-quest hardcoded PWA execution links and make future Quest creation action-complete and Growth-reviewed by default without changing Neon ownership, quest rewards, or real-world authority.

roles_before.artifact: Neon/PostgreSQL system_events owns Quest state; quest.created description is canonical quest copy.
player-utility.js currently exposes the current Bebris execution button through hardcoded quest id + URL.
system-controller creates/scopes Quest v2 and may include a source link in description.
system-growth:v1 permits one prospective quest.growth.assign mapping; future controller application is currently optional and can be forgotten.
XMind strategy context is separate read-only metadata and must never be mistaken for execution action.
Service worker owns cached PWA assets only; it is not state truth.
Git history and immutable ledger preserve prior behavior/events.

role_dispositions.destination: No new quest state owner or event type. Existing description remains canonical and immutable per quest.created.
A pure generic questExecutionAction helper derives a button only when quest description contains exactly one safe http(s) execution URL; no per-quest frontend constants.
Controller assembly rule requires one clear canonical execution URL in description when a stable external resource materially reduces friction.

Controller performs a same-turn Growth Review after Quest creation/focus and writes quest.growth.assign when the mapping is unambiguous and policy-valid; ambiguous targets are omitted rather than guessed.
Strategy/XMind references remain separate and cannot create an execution button.
New helper is added to the existing shell cache with a cache version bump.
No ledger rewrite; reverting the PWA/controller change restores prior presentation while historical quests remain intact.

capability_probes.assertion: Any quest with exactly one safe http(s) URL in its description gets an execution action without a code deploy or quest-id whitelist.
Current Bebris lesson 3 still exposes its lesson execution action from its canonical description after hardcoded constants are removed.
A description with multiple distinct URLs yields no inferred primary execution button, preventing arbitrary routing.
Strategy/XMind metadata alone never produces an execution action.
Controller contract requires a Growth Review on new Quest creation/focus and immediately assigns only unambiguous valid growth mappings.
Quest rewards, focus, deadlines, Challenge, evidence resolution, Skill Mastery math and real-world authority are unchanged.
The PWA remains installable/offline with the new helper cached and no player APIs cached.
No existing ledger event is mutated or retroactively reinterpreted; Git history is sufficient rollback provenance.

tests.expected: single URL, current Bebris copy, punctuation and multi-URL fail-closed cases PASS.

tests.command: cd system/lifeup/cloud && node --test test/player-utility.test.mjs test/pwa-contract.test.mjs test/ui-polish.test.mjs
tests.expected: current action surface, shell cache and presentation regressions PASS.
Quest controller keeps action-complete execution and Growth Review rules.
PWA focused contracts and zero-credential shell remain green.
